messages.content: Rewrite plain English in the manner of Hegel's writing, as his nineteenth-century English translators render it. Keep the content exactly: every claim, example and step, in the same order, and add nothing.

Rewrite in Hegel's manner:

The haze sits upon the city like a veil that refuses to lift, obscuring the sun yet failing to obscure the dust of the world. I am at the gate of the gardens, possessing six rupees, which is a sum so pitiful it renders the concept of property itself a mere joke; I cannot even purchase the water to quench the thirst that the heat has drawn from me. I remain here, sitting on the stone, watching the traffic flow past like a river of iron that carries no meaning, only motion.
